church.name: Lightwell Church
church.pastors: Theo and Priya lead Lightwell together. They started it in 2023 with eleven friends, a borrowed sound system and a lot of coffee. They teach as a team, they are raising two busy kids, and they would love to meet you after either gathering.
church.kids: Yes. Lightwell Kids runs at both gatherings, for babies through 5th grade. Check-in opens 20 minutes early, and every volunteer is background checked. The rooms are bright, safe and a lot of fun.
church.students: Students in grades 6 to 12 meet during the week, and our young adults group is for twentysomethings. Both have a few big nights out each season, and both are easy to drop into.
church.groups: We have 14 small groups across Raleigh. Ten or so people, a living room and real conversation. It is the fastest way to go from new face to friend.
church.startHere: So glad you found us. Come on a Sunday at 9:00 or 10:45, grab a coffee from 8:30 and tell us it is your first time. When you are ready, come to Start Here, a lunch with Theo and Priya where you hear where Lightwell is headed and find your spot.
church.give: You can give online in about a minute, once or every month. Your giving stocks the pantry, builds the bright new kids rooms for Room to Grow and keeps the coffee on for whoever walks in next.
church.watch: Every message is online by Monday morning. The newest is Room for questions, week 3 of Open Doors, with Pastor Theo. It works great in the car, on a walk or during nap time.
church.prayer: Big or small, bring it. A real person on our prayer team reads every request and would love to pray with you. If you are in crisis, call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
church.values: We are a young church for people who are still figuring it out. So, all of us. We care about honest questions, real friendships, grace for the tired and loving Raleigh well.
